verdict.rationale: Jan's README and dedicated API-server docs describe a built-in, OpenAI-compatible local server at localhost:1337, powered by llama.cpp, that works as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs. It can also be bound to 0.0.0.0 for access from other devices on the local network. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that any loaded model (rather than llama.cpp-served local models) can be exposed through the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
